description: Add collateral to an existing position: approval (if needed) and deposit(amount). Checks both caps. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

amount.description: Collateral to add, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

name: prepare_deposit
title: Prepare deposit
